title: Monthly Exercise Set
description: Schema for a month's low-intensity, knee-aware exercise rotation. Every exercise must offer a seated and a standing option and a safety cue (non-negotiable).

month.description: Content month in YYYY-MM form, e.g. 2026-01.

source_note.description: Where the set was curated from and the required-review disclaimer.

exercises.description: Exactly ten exercises so one fires per weekday hour (8am-5pm).

id.description: Stable slug; also used for rotation bookkeeping.

intensity.description: This feed ships low-intensity only; moderate is allowed by schema but discouraged.

seatedVariant.description: How to perform it seated. Required even for seated-default moves (say 'done seated').

safetyCue.description: A stop-if-it-hurts style cue. Required on every exercise.

illustration.description: Bundle-relative image path, e.g. images/ankle-circles.png. May be null; UI falls back to a symbol.

videoUrl.description: Optional link to a vetted AARP/Mayo demo. Never an embedded third-party player.
